style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, warm autumn colours, simple clean background, gentle camera movement, no text, no letters, no words on screen, no speech, only soft natural sound effects.

words.scene: A determined little cartoon ant pushes a big red strawberry up a steep grassy hill, slipping a little but never stopping, wind blowing and rain drops falling, it keeps pushing forward with all its strength.

A cartoon boy at a kitchen table holds his rumbling tummy with both hands and looks weak and very hungry, then a big plate of warm food is placed in front of him and his eyes go wide as he grabs a spoon.
A cartoon girl waits backstage behind a red curtain before her turn, biting her lip, twisting her fingers together and taking a shaky breath as she peeks out at the audience.

A cartoon tiger leaps onto a big rock in the jungle and lets out a fierce, powerful roar showing its big teeth, leaves blowing back from the force; bold and strong but suitable for children, not scary.
A cartoon boy looks at the camera with a cheeky smile, then slowly and on purpose reaches out one finger and taps the first domino, starting a long colourful chain of dominoes falling.
A cartoon girl in a white lab coat and goggles fits the last piece into a glowing science machine; a bright light bulb pops on above her head and she jumps and cheers proudly.
